description: Validity range of user reheating scenarios for methodology v2 (fixed cosmology, Fuzzy arXiv:2412.12012 constant pre-reheating equation of state w_R per scenario). Hard constraints stop the run; warnings are recorded with the results and never change a number. T_reh constraints are those of v1 and do not depend on w_R.

hard_constraints.T_reh_above_T_eq: T_reh > T_eq (the relic driver's own check; below T_eq the pre/post-reheating split of the v1 methodology does not apply)
hard_constraints.T_reh_inside_gstar_table: T_min(g* table) <= T_reh <= T_max(g* table): no extrapolation of g_rho, g_s (data/standardmodel2018.dat, arXiv:1803.01038)
hard_constraints.H_R_below_H_I_max: 3 H_R < 3 H_I,max (the relic driver's own check; reheating after the end of inflation)
hard_constraints.pair_unique: a (T_reh_GeV, w_R) pair appears at most once in a run (two labels for identical physics would be ambiguous)

warnings.bbn_warning: T_reh below 5 MeV: at or below the lower bounds of a few MeV on the reheating temperature quoted in the BBN / neutrino-decoupling literature; the computation is performed but the scenario is cosmologically disfavoured
warnings.bbn_edge_note: T_reh below 10 MeV: within a factor of 2 of the BBN-motivated lower bounds; interpret with care
warnings.accelerated_warning: w_R < -1/3: the pre-reheating epoch is accelerating (a_ddot > 0), i.e. it is a continuation of inflation-like expansion rather than a conventional reheating epoch; the instantaneous transition to radiation then needs a microphysical interpretation that this prescription does not provide
warnings.near_de_sitter_warning: w_R < -0.9: 1+z_a ~ (m/3H_R)^(2/(3(1+w_R))) grows very steeply; abundances can leave the float64 range and the run stops if one does (never clamped)
warnings.radiation_like_warning: w_R = 1/3: the pre-reheating epoch is radiation-like, so the PRE prescription describes an extended radiation era; ok mathematically, check that this is the intended history
warnings.onset_systematic_note: w_R < 0: the sudden-onset (3H = m) estimate overestimates the exact field evolution by a factor that grows quickly as w_R decreases (idealised constant-mass power-law setups: 4.0 at w_R = 0, 10.6 at -1/3, 28 at -1/2; METHODOLOGY.md, Methodology v2); results are results of the stated prescription, not precision predictions, and no output is rescaled

label_rule: labels are used in file names: 1-32 characters from [A-Za-z0-9.+-], unique within a run
